Hello and welcome!

/v/DevDiary is your place for posting development updates on your own personal projects, and even on other projects that you know about.

This sub was created with beginners in mind, but can very well be used by even the most professional to get direct feedback about their project.

What we'd like to see:

  • Post your own projects.
  • Ask questions about development, features, ideas, etc!
  • Ask for feedback. (Bug testing, looks, features, etc.)
  • Post updates about your project!
  • Help other projects with what they are asking.
  • Direct users to subs or resources that could help them easier.
  • Most of all, be constructive.

Try not to bash a project because you disagree with what it's doing. but also report projects that are potentially illegal or malicious.
